Brief Job Description

Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) Community Services’ division seeks a highly qualified candidate to fill the Data Analyst IV position within Business Operations. Community Services is a division within Behavioral Health, Disability & Aging Services (BHDAS). The ideal candidate excels in teamwork, upholds high standards and accountability, embraces curiosity and learning, applies critical thinking to tasks, and uses creativity for innovation. Reporting to the Manager of Data and System Operations, the Data Analyst IV handles advanced data analysis and research tasks. Work consists of analyzing data, researching extensively, delivering results, creating interactive dashboards, and ensuring data quality. The position supports all Community Services programs and initiatives division-wide. Serves as a subject matter expert in data analysis, data quality, reporting, and performance measurements. Analyzes content, structure, and relationships within data to identify trends, patterns, gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement. Works closely with program stakeholders to understand business requirements, develops reporting solutions, and supports data-driven decision making. Provides recommendations regarding systematic changes that improve data collection processes and aligns data infrastructure with business needs. May mentor staff and provide technical guidance related to reporting, analytics, and data visualization initiatives.

Additional responsibilities include reporting activities for the division through the preparation and analysis of a variety of data. This encompasses, but is not limited to, Community Services measurements of success, program metrics, legislative budget board performance, as well as workforce, financial, system, and management reports.

May provide guidance to others through mentorship and training regarding analytics tools, data interpretation, reporting methodologies, and best practices. Works under general supervision, with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

EJF 1: Business Operations Data Analysis (30%)

Prepares concise, comprehensive technical reports to interpret and present divisional data to CS leadership. Acquires data from different sources and reviews the information through multiple database resources to provide accurate and understandable analysis. Responsible for accurate reporting, along with the development of a variety of reporting outputs to meet the needs of multiple internal and external stakeholders. Analyzes divisional program and financial data to reveal trends and drive strategy. Identifies data gaps, errors, anomalies, inconsistencies, and redundancies in data sources and reporting processes. Works with stakeholders to improve data integrity.

EJF 2: Coordination and Process Implementation (30%)

Leads divisional coordination of data and compiles results to report program and divisional progress towards successfully meeting performance measurements. Assists with the development of processes and procedures to ensure data is consistently and routinely reported at the division level. Assists in developing data quality measures, analyzing data quality results, and implementing necessary changes to ensure data quality and improvement. Plans, develops, and conducts projects related to statistical and data analyses.

Coordinates with program areas to initiate program evaluation studies and quality improvement initiatives including design, implementation, analysis, and evaluation. Collaborates with program areas, leadership, and subject matter experts to identify reporting requirements, business needs, and develop meaningful metrics, visualizations, and reporting solutions. Designs engaging and interactive business insight dashboards for program staff, leadership and stakeholders to make informed programmatic decisions. EJF 4: Technical Assistance (15%)

EJF 5: Other Duties as Assigned (5%)

Adhoc assignments related to program areas, special assignments and other duties as assigned. Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the division and agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Knowledge of developing, maintaining and managing data driven dashboards and analytics using Power BI, Tableau, SmartSheets or other data visualization tools.

Knowledge and experience on data visualization best practices, with focus on enhancing user interaction and user experience. Knowledge of statistics and analyzing large and complex data sets and running queries.

Skill in analyzing problems and devising effective solutions.
